high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from "Gadgets Now" by The Times of India. The time displayed at the top of the screen is 4:41, and the battery level and Wi-Fi signal indicators are also visible. The webpage content discusses Steve Jobs and Apple's approach to product development. It highlights how Steve Jobs emphasized the importance of meeting human needs before focusing on technical specifications. The text mentions that Steve Jobs famously said, "People don’t know what they want until you show it to them," which he believed was an insight rather than arrogance.
